passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take Aaron and his sons, their garments, the anointing oil, the bull of the sin offering, the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread, and assemble the whole congregation at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Take Aaron.
Take Aaron’s sons with him.
Take the garments.
Take the anointing oil.
Take the bull for the sin offering.
Take the two rams.
Take the basket of unleavened bread.
Gather the whole congregation.
Bring them to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ קַ֤ח אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֣יו אִתּ֔וֹ וְאֵת֙ הַבְּגָדִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֑ה וְאֵ֣ת׀ פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֗את וְאֵת֙ שְׁנֵ֣י הָֽאֵילִ֔ים וְאֵ֖ת סַ֥ל הַמַּצּֽוֹת׃ וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֖ה הַקְהֵ֑ל אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him, and the assembly gathered at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
Moses obeyed the LORD.
The LORD had commanded Moses.
Moses did what the LORD said.
The people of Israel gathered together.
They came to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּֽאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ וַתִּקָּהֵל֙ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה אֶל־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: And Moses said to them, “This is what the LORD has commanded to be done.”
passages.sermon: Moses spoke to the whole assembly.\r\nHe said, “The LORD has given a command.\r\nThis is what the LORD has told us to do.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־ הָעֵדָ֑ה זֶ֣ה הַדָּבָ֔ר אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃

passages.text: Then Moses presented Aaron and his sons and washed them with water.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was Moses' brother.
Aaron's sons were with him.
Moses brought Aaron and his sons forward.
Moses washed Aaron and his sons with water.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֣ב מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֑יו וַיִּרְחַ֥ץ אֹתָ֖ם בַּמָּֽיִם׃

passages.text: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him. He tied the woven band of the ephod around him and fastened it to him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was his brother.
Aaron was chosen to be the high priest.
Moses put the tunic on Aaron.
Moses tied the sash around Aaron.
Moses put the robe on Aaron.
Moses put the ephod on Aaron.
Moses tied the woven band of the ephod around Aaron.
Moses fastened the ephod to Aaron.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן עָלָ֜יו אֶת־ הַכֻּתֹּ֗נֶת וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ בָּֽאַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּלְבֵּ֤שׁ אֹתוֹ֙ אֶֽת־ הַמְּעִ֔יל וַיִּתֵּ֥ן עָלָ֖יו אֶת־ הָאֵפֹ֑ד וַיַּחְגֹּ֣ר אֹת֗וֹ בְּחֵ֙שֶׁב֙ הָֽאֵפֹ֔ד וַיֶּאְפֹּ֥ד ל֖וֹ בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Then he put the breastpiece on him and placed the Urim and Thummim in the breastpiece.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the brother of Moses.
Aaron was chosen to be the high priest.
Moses put the breastpiece on Aaron.
Moses placed the Urim and Thummim inside the breastpiece.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם עָלָ֖יו אֶת־ הַחֹ֑שֶׁן וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶל־ הַחֹ֔שֶׁן אֶת־ הָאוּרִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַתֻּמִּֽים׃

passages.text: Moses also put the turban on Aaron’s head and set the gold plate, the holy diadem, on the front of the turban, as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was his brother.
Aaron was chosen to be the high priest.
Moses put the turban on Aaron’s head.
Moses placed the gold plate on the front of the turban.
The gold plate was called the holy diadem.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֶת־ הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת עַל־ רֹאשׁ֑וֹ וַיָּ֨שֶׂם עַֽל־ הַמִּצְנֶ֜פֶת אֶל־ מ֣וּל פָּנָ֗יו אֵ֣ת צִ֤יץ הַזָּהָב֙ נֵ֣זֶר הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Next, Moses took the anointing oil and anointed the tabernacle and everything in it; and so he consecrated them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took the anointing oil.
He anointed the tabernacle.
He anointed everything inside the tabernacle.
He consecrated the tabernacle and all its contents.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ שֶׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֖שׁ אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: He sprinkled some of the oil on the altar seven times, anointing the altar and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand, to consecrate them.
passages.sermon:
Moses acted as the leader of Israel.
Moses took some of the anointing oil.
He sprinkled the oil on the altar.
He did this seven times.
Moses anointed the altar.
He anointed all the altar’s utensils.
He anointed the basin.
He anointed the stand for the basin.
Moses did this to make them holy.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥ז מִמֶּ֛נּוּ עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וַיִּמְשַׁ֨ח אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֜חַ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֗יו וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֛ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּ֖וֹ לְקַדְּשָֽׁם׃

passages.text: He also poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head and anointed him to consecrate him.
passages.sermon:
Moses took the anointing oil.
Moses poured the oil on Aaron’s head.
Moses anointed Aaron.
Moses did this to set Aaron apart as holy.
passages.original: וַיִּצֹק֙ מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֔ה עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ אַהֲרֹ֑ן וַיִּמְשַׁ֥ח אֹת֖וֹ לְקַדְּשֽׁוֹ׃

passages.text: Then Moses presented Aaron’s sons, put tunics on them, wrapped sashes around them, and tied headbands on them, just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses led Aaron’s sons forward.
Moses put tunics on Aaron’s sons.
Moses wrapped sashes around them.
Moses tied headbands on their heads.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
Moses obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֨ב מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיַּלְבִּשֵׁ֤ם כֻּתֳּנֹת֙ וַיַּחְגֹּ֤ר אֹתָם֙ אַבְנֵ֔ט וַיַּחֲבֹ֥שׁ לָהֶ֖ם מִגְבָּע֑וֹת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Moses then brought the bull near for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses brought the bull close.
The bull was for the sin offering.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron’s sons were priests.
Aaron and his sons put their hands on the bull’s head.
passages.original: וַיַּגֵּ֕שׁ אֵ֖ת פַּ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֑את וַיִּסְמֹ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֤ן וּבָנָיו֙ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ רֹ֖אשׁ פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: Moses slaughtered the bull, took some of the blood, and applied it with his finger to all four horns of the altar, purifying the altar. He poured out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar and consecrated it so that atonement could be made on it.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses slaughtered the bull.
Moses took some of the blood from the bull.
Moses used his finger to apply the blood.
Moses put the blood on all four horns of the altar.
Moses purified the altar by doing this.
Moses poured the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
Moses consecrated the altar with the blood.
This made atonement possible on the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁחָ֗ט וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ הַדָּם֙ וַ֠יִּתֵּן עַל־ קַרְנ֨וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֤חַ סָבִיב֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וַיְחַטֵּ֖א אֶת־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְאֶת־ הַדָּ֗ם יָצַק֙ אֶל־ יְס֣וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וַֽיְקַדְּשֵׁ֖הוּ לְכַפֵּ֥ר עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Moses also took all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys and their fat, and burned it all on the altar.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took all the fat that was on the entrails.
Moses took the lobe of the liver.
Moses took both kidneys and their fat.
Moses burned all these parts on the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֗ח אֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־ חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר מֹשֶׁ֖ה הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃

passages.text: But the bull with its hide, flesh, and dung he burned outside the camp, as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses took the bull.
He took its hide.
He took its flesh.
He took its dung.
Moses burned all of these with fire.
He burned them outside the camp.
The LORD had commanded Moses to do this.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַפָּ֤ר וְאֶת־ עֹרוֹ֙ וְאֶת־ בְּשָׂר֣וֹ וְאֶת־ פִּרְשׁ֔וֹ שָׂרַ֣ף בָּאֵ֔שׁ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Then Moses presented the ram for the burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses brought a ram.
The ram was for a burnt offering.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
Aaron and his sons put their hands on the ram’s head.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֕ב אֵ֖ת אֵ֣יל הָעֹלָ֑ה וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

passages.text: Moses slaughtered the ram and sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Moses acted as the leader and priest for Israel.
Moses took the ram.
Moses slaughtered the ram.
Moses collected the blood from the ram.
Moses sprinkled the blood on every side of the altar.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁחָ֑ט וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־ הַדָּ֛ם עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: He cut the ram into pieces and burned the head, the pieces, and the fat.
passages.sermon:
Moses took the ram.
He cut the ram into pieces.
He burned the head.
He burned the pieces.
He burned the fat.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַ֔יִל נִתַּ֖ח לִנְתָחָ֑יו וַיַּקְטֵ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־ הַנְּתָחִ֖ים וְאֶת־ הַפָּֽדֶר׃

passages.text: He washed the entrails and legs with water and burned the entire ram on the altar as a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
God gave Moses commands.
Moses washed the entrails of the ram with water.
He washed the legs of the ram with water.
Moses burned the entire ram on the altar.
This was a burnt offering.
The offering made a pleasing aroma.
The offering was made by fire to the LORD.
Moses did this just as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ הַקֶּ֥רֶב וְאֶת־ הַכְּרָעַ֖יִם רָחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וַיַּקְטֵר֩ מֹשֶׁ֨ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָאַ֜יִל הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חָה עֹלָ֨ה ה֤וּא לְרֵֽיחַ־ נִיחֹ֙חַ֙ אִשֶּׁ֥ה הוּא֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: After that, Moses presented the other ram, the ram of ordination, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on its head.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses presented the second ram.
This ram was for ordination.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron and his sons were priests.
Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵב֙ אֶת־ הָאַ֣יִל הַשֵּׁנִ֔י אֵ֖יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים וַֽיִּסְמְכ֞וּ אַהֲרֹ֧ן וּבָנָ֛יו אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הָאָֽיִל׃

passages.text: Moses slaughtered the ram and took some of its blood and put it on Aaron’s right earlobe, on the thumb of his right hand, and on the big toe of his right foot.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took a ram.
Moses slaughtered the ram.
Moses took some of the ram’s blood.
Aaron was the high priest.
Moses put blood on Aaron’s right earlobe.
Moses put blood on the thumb of Aaron’s right hand.
Moses put blood on the big toe of Aaron’s right foot.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁחָ֓ט׀ וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ מִדָּמ֔וֹ וַיִּתֵּ֛ן עַל־ תְּנ֥וּךְ אֹֽזֶן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַיְמָנִ֑ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדוֹ֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְל֖וֹ הַיְמָנִֽית׃

passages.text: Moses also presented Aaron’s sons and put some of the blood on their right earlobes, on the thumbs of their right hands, and on the big toes of their right feet. Then he sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Aaron was the high priest.
Aaron had sons who served as priests.
Moses brought Aaron’s sons forward.
Moses took some of the blood from the ram of ordination.
Moses put the blood on the right earlobe of each son of Aaron.
Moses put the blood on the thumb of each son’s right hand.
Moses put the blood on the big toe of each son’s right foot.
Moses sprinkled the blood on all sides of the altar.
passages.original: וַיַּקְרֵ֞ב אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֗ן וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֤ה מִן־ הַדָּם֙ עַל־ תְּנ֤וּךְ אָזְנָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֤הֶן יָדָם֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית וְעַל־ בֹּ֥הֶן רַגְלָ֖ם הַיְמָנִ֑ית וַיִּזְרֹ֨ק מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־ הַדָּ֛ם עַל־ הַֽמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And Moses took the fat—the fat tail, all the fat that was on the entrails, the lobe of the liver, and both kidneys with their fat—as well as the right thigh.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took the fat from the ram.
He took the fat tail.
He took all the fat that was on the entrails.
He took the lobe of the liver.
He took both kidneys with their fat.
He took the right thigh.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֞ח אֶת־ הַחֵ֣לֶב וְאֶת־ הָֽאַלְיָ֗ה וְאֶֽת־ כָּל־ הַחֵלֶב֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַקֶּרֶב֒ וְאֵת֙ יֹתֶ֣רֶת הַכָּבֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ שְׁתֵּ֥י הַכְּלָיֹ֖ת וְאֶֽת־ חֶלְבְּהֶ֑ן וְאֵ֖ת שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

passages.text: And from the basket of unleavened bread that was before the LORD, he took one cake of unleavened bread, one cake of bread made with oil, and one wafer, and he placed them on the fat portions and on the right thigh.
passages.sermon:
Moses stood before the LORD.
A basket of unleavened bread was there.
Moses took one cake of unleavened bread from the basket.
He took one cake of bread made with oil.
He took one wafer.
Moses placed the cake of unleavened bread, the cake of bread with oil, and the wafer on the fat portions.
He also placed them on the right thigh.
passages.original: וּמִסַּ֨ל הַמַּצּ֜וֹת אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֗ה לָ֠קַח חַלַּ֨ת מַצָּ֤ה אַחַת֙ וְֽחַלַּ֨ת לֶ֥חֶם שֶׁ֛מֶן אַחַ֖ת וְרָקִ֣יק אֶחָ֑ד וַיָּ֙שֶׂם֙ עַל־ הַ֣חֲלָבִ֔ים וְעַ֖ל שׁ֥וֹק הַיָּמִֽין׃

passages.text: He put all these in the hands of Aaron and his sons and waved them before the LORD as a wave offering.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel and the priestly ordination ceremony.
Moses took all the items for the offering.
He placed them in the hands of Aaron.
He also placed them in the hands of Aaron’s sons.
Moses waved the items before the LORD.
This was a wave offering to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶת־ הַכֹּ֔ל עַ֚ל כַּפֵּ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן וְעַ֖ל כַּפֵּ֣י בָנָ֑יו וַיָּ֧נֶף אֹתָ֛ם תְּנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Moses took these from their hands and burned them on the altar with the burnt offering. This was an ordination offering, a pleasing aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel and the servant of God.
Moses took the items from the hands of Aaron and his sons.
He burned the items on the altar.
He burned them together with the burnt offering.
These items were for the ordination offering.
The offering gave a pleasing aroma.
The offering was made by fire to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֹתָם֙ מֵעַ֣ל כַּפֵּיהֶ֔ם וַיַּקְטֵ֥ר הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חָה עַל־ הָעֹלָ֑ה מִלֻּאִ֥ים הֵם֙ לְרֵ֣יחַ נִיחֹ֔חַ אִשֶּׁ֥ה ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: He also took the breast—Moses’ portion of the ram of ordination—and waved it before the LORD as a wave offering, as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
God commanded Moses to ordain Aaron and his sons as priests.
Moses took the breast of the ram used for ordination.
This breast was Moses’ portion from the ram.
Moses waved the breast before the LORD.
He presented it as a wave offering.
Moses did this because the LORD had commanded him.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֤ח מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣חָזֶ֔ה וַיְנִיפֵ֥הוּ תְנוּפָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מֵאֵ֣יל הַמִּלֻּאִ֗ים לְמֹשֶׁ֤ה הָיָה֙ לְמָנָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: Next, Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar and sprinkled them on Aaron and his garments, and on his sons and their garments. So he consecrated Aaron and his garments, as well as Aaron’s sons and their garments.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses took some anointing oil.
Moses also took some blood from the altar.
Moses sprinkled the oil and blood on Aaron.
Moses sprinkled them on Aaron’s garments.
Moses sprinkled them on Aaron’s sons.
Moses sprinkled them on the garments of Aaron’s sons.
Moses consecrated Aaron.
Moses consecrated Aaron’s garments.
Moses consecrated Aaron’s sons.
Moses consecrated the garments of Aaron’s sons.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֨ח מֹשֶׁ֜ה מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֗ה וּמִן־ הַדָּם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמִּזְבֵּחַ֒ וַיַּ֤ז עַֽל־ אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְעַל־ בָּנָ֛יו וְעַל־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּ֑וֹ וַיְקַדֵּ֤שׁ אֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת־ בְּגָדָ֔יו וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֛יו וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו אִתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, “Boil the meat at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and eat it there with the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons are to eat it.’
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and to Aaron’s sons.
Moses gave them instructions.
He told them to boil the meat.
He told them to do this at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
He told them to eat the meat there.
He told them to eat the bread that is in the basket of ordination offerings.
Moses said he had commanded this before.
He said, “Aaron and his sons are to eat it.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן וְאֶל־ בָּנָ֗יו בַּשְּׁל֣וּ אֶת־ הַבָּשָׂר֮ פֶּ֣תַח אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵד֒ וְשָׁם֙ תֹּאכְל֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ וְאֶ֨ת־ הַלֶּ֔חֶם אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּסַ֣ל הַמִּלֻּאִ֑ים כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר צִוֵּ֙יתִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו יֹאכְלֻֽהוּ׃

passages.text: Then you must burn up the remainder of the meat and bread.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons.
He gave them instructions for the ordination ceremony.
He said, “Burn the leftover meat in the fire.
Burn the leftover bread in the fire.”
passages.original: וְהַנּוֹתָ֥ר בַּבָּשָׂ֖ר וּבַלָּ֑חֶם בָּאֵ֖שׁ תִּשְׂרֹֽפוּ׃

passages.text: You must not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your ordination are complete; for it will take seven days to ordain you.
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons.
Aaron and his sons were being ordained as priests.
Moses said, “Do not go outside the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
Stay there for seven days.
Remain until your days of ordination are complete.
Your ordination will take seven days.”
passages.original: וּמִפֶּתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד לֹ֤א תֵֽצְאוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים עַ֚ד י֣וֹם מְלֹ֔את יְמֵ֖י מִלֻּאֵיכֶ֑ם כִּ֚י שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים יְמַלֵּ֖א אֶת־ יֶדְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: What has been done today has been commanded by the LORD in order to make atonement on your behalf.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave a command.
He told us what to do today.
We did these things today because the LORD commanded them.
The LORD commanded these actions to make atonement for you.
passages.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לַעֲשֹׂ֖ת לְכַפֵּ֥ר עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must remain at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting day and night for seven days and keep the LORD’s charge so that you will not die, for this is what I have been commanded.”
passages.sermon:
Moses spoke to Aaron and his sons.
He gave them a command from the LORD.
He said, “You must stay at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
You must remain there day and night.
You must do this for seven days.
You must keep the LORD’s charge.
If you obey, you will not die.
I have been commanded to tell you this.”
passages.original: וּפֶתַח֩ אֹ֨הֶל מוֹעֵ֜ד תֵּשְׁב֨וּ יוֹמָ֤ם וָלַ֙יְלָה֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֛ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת יְהוָ֖ה וְלֹ֣א תָמ֑וּתוּ כִּי־ כֵ֖ן צֻוֵּֽיתִי׃

passages.text: So Aaron and his sons did everything the LORD had commanded through Moses.
passages.sermon:
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
His sons served as priests with him.
The LORD gave commands to Israel.
The LORD spoke these commands through Moses.
Aaron and his sons obeyed the LORD.
They did everything the LORD commanded through Moses.
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּבָנָ֑יו אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס
